title: How Do I Find a Home Birth Midwife Near Me?
card: Most couples in our surveys found their home birth midwife through friends or family. Where to look, what the credentials mean, and the partner's job in the search.
llms: Where couples find a home birth midwife (referrals, doulas, local groups, the coming Go Boil the Water directory), what CNM, CM and CPM mean per ACNM, and the partner's role in choosing one.
